text: Design plan complete: PLAN.md, docs 01-12, research notes

Release preset builds: tm_core, tm_gpu, tracemaker CLI, tm_tests
5/5 tests pass; Philox kernel bit-identical to CPU on V100 and P100
Preset cpu-only: build and tests passed
Preset asan: build and tests passed
Progress website running on 0.0.0.0:8765 (systemd user service tracemaker-devsite)
Fixtures fetched: Freerouting (166 regression DSN + 1,158 PCBench boards), DAC2020 bm1-bm11, KiCad 10 demos (19 boards)
M0 complete: gate met (CPU + CUDA tests pass on V100 and P100; kicad-cli 10.0.6 works from the harness)

Design-rule loader: net classes (with Default inheritance), patterns, explicit assignments, board minimums, custom .kicad_dru rules
Dashboard: added syntax-highlighted Latest code panel (requested)
Edited boards (moves, 90°/45° rotations, removals, new tracks/vias) read identically in KiCad 10 and TraceMaker on 3 demo boards
M1 complete: 3,538 fixture boards parse and round-trip byte for byte; schematic netlist matches board pad nets
M2 core done: DRC matches kicad-cli exactly on 11/16 demo boards; rule sources verified against KiCad behaviour; remaining gaps documented
First routed board: PCBench 1-Wire-Wing 43/48 connections in 7.5 s with zero added KiCad DRC errors
Benchmark m4-tierA-v1 (40 PCBench tier-A boards): 70% clean pass vs Freerouting 2.5.0-RC12 100% / 2.4.1 87.5% on the same boards; 1 board with added DRC errors
Benchmark m5-tierA-v2: 92.5% clean pass on 40 tier-A boards (Freerouting RC12 100%, 2.4.1 87.5%), 99.6% completion, zero added DRC errors
M3 complete (helper agent): live WebGL2 viewer + Boost.Beast event server, tracemaker-view with demo mode
tracemaker route --view streams routing live to the browser viewer (port 8766)
Tier B (40 boards) with an 8-variant portfolio: 42.5% clean pass (Freerouting RC12 50%, 2.4.1 12.5%); 5 boards clean only with TraceMaker
Portfolio benchmarks (40 boards each): tier A 97.5% clean (FR RC12 100%, 2.4.1 87.5%), tier B 45% (FR RC12 50%, 2.4.1 12.5%); zero added DRC errors
Failure memory across runs: SQLite knowledge base with a Thompson-sampling bandit over router variants and per-board failure priorities
GPU cost-to-go fields: CUDA kernel equals CPU reference exactly; routed boards byte-identical with and without GPU
Deterministic routing: --work budget makes runs byte-reproducible; aquarius 171/171 with an 8-variant portfolio
Started final benchmark set (tiers A/B/C, 120 s per board, 8-variant portfolio)
Final tier A (40 boards, 120 s): 100% clean pass, 100% completion, zero added DRC errors (Freerouting 2.5.0-RC12 100%, 2.4.1 87.5%)
Final tier B (40 boards, 120 s): 50.0% clean = Freerouting 2.5.0-RC12 50.0% (2.4.1: 12.5%), zero added errors. Tier C (30): 36.7% vs RC12 46.7% (2.4.1: 16.7%)
KiCad IPC plugin: autoroutes the open board in one undoable commit (offline-tested against kicad-python 0.8)
final3 PCBench (120 s, 8 variants): tier A 100% clean (FR RC12 100%), tier B 55.0% (FR 50.0%), tier C 46.7% (FR 46.7%); zero router-introduced DRC errors on all 110 boards
M7 placement v1 committed: B2B + SimPL + legalisation + parallel annealing + LP lower bound; HPWL down, routability not yet up (opt-in tool tracemaker-place)
Router: Horticulture mask fix, reverse boxed-in probe, pad-leg drop, portfolio early stop
final4 PCBench (120 s, 8 variants): tier B 60.0% clean (FR RC12 50.0%), tier C 50.0% (FR RC12 46.7%); zero router-introduced DRC errors
final5 PCBench: A 100%, B 60.0%, C 53.3%, D 52.4% clean (FR RC12 100/50.0/46.7/38.1%); zero router-introduced DRC errors
Auto placement with route checks on 23 boards: HPWL -24.5% total, unrouted 61 -> 59, never worse
final7 PCBench: A 100%, B 62.5%, C 56.7%, D 52.4% clean (FR RC12 100/50.0/46.7/38.1%); zero router-introduced DRC errors
final8 PCBench: A 100%, B 65.0%, C 56.7%, D 50.0% (22 boards) clean (FR RC12 100/50.0/46.7/36.4%); zero router-introduced DRC errors; no harness errors
Held-out quality benchmark (60 unseen PCBench boards, same machine, KiCad DRC judge): TraceMaker clean 73-78%, Freerouting 2.5.0-RC12 3% (78% connected), Freerouting 1.9.0 32% (66% connected)
Freerouting failures are mostly board-edge clearance / minimum track width (rules not in the Specctra file); both versions also had real clearance errors on 9-10 boards and shorts on 3-4
Router clean-up stage: via-saving re-routes + path smoothing, via cost 3 mm. vs FR 2.5: vias ratio 2.15 -> 1.43, bends 1.20 -> 0.72, length 0.95
Fixed: text on solder-mask layers now opens the mask (found on held-out boards FRM16 and MySensors IR Blaster)
final9 PCBench with clean-up: A 100%, B 65.0%, C 60.0%, D 54.5% clean (FR RC12 published 100/50.0/46.7/36.4%); zero router-introduced DRC errors
Comparison video: TraceMaker vs Freerouting 2.5 and 1.9 routing AmpOne (4x real time, KiCad-judged metrics) - on the dashboard and in report/compare_AmpOne.mp4
M6 global routing v1 (CPU, soft corridors) built and measured: no gain yet on 3 boards; kept off by default (--global)
Clean-up: region rip-up around vias added (small gain, e.g. AmpOne 59 -> 57 vias)
M3 gate: tracemaker-view --replay plays a recorded routing log; integration test confirms the replay reproduces the routed board exactly
DRC parity: same-number pads are one pad, same-footprint overlapping pads connect, chamfered round-rect pads; jetson demo now matches KiCad exactly (12 of 17 demo boards)
DAC 2020 (10 boards, same machine, KiCad judge): TraceMaker clean 60% (human originals 60%), Freerouting 2.5 10%, 1.9 20%; fixed footprint mask-opening bug (bm10/bm11 now complete)
final10 PCBench: A 100% (mask-tierA), B 67.5%, C 60.0%, D 50.0% clean (FR RC12 published 100/50.0/46.7/36.4%); zero router-introduced DRC errors

M11: Python bindings (tracemaker module: read_board, route, emit_items, drc; byte-identical to the CLI), plugin uses the module when importable, PCM package build/pcm/tracemaker-0.1.0.zip passes kicad-python 0.8's validator. GUI round trip and PCM GUI install still untested.
M11 quick check: PCBench tier A 30 boards 20 s: 27/30 clean, 0 added DRC errors, per-board routed counts identical to the pre-change binary; ctest release 46/46, asan 43/43 (kicad label excluded)
Placement test plan written (docs/14): unit/property/board/routability/baseline/human-review levels, held-out and from-scratch sets, design-intent metrics, gates G1-G7

M8 placement (CPU): parallel tempering, LNS + exact B&B windows, RUDY term, --mode routable and --mode eco. 23 PCBench boards at 3M x 4 router budget: unrouted human 64, auto 60, routable 35, eco 48; fully routed 16/17/19/19; 0 new KiCad DRC errors; HPWL -29% (routable). Schematic-to-board gate not measured (set S missing).
Held-out tier C (30 unseen boards, same machine, KiCad judge): TraceMaker clean 43%, Freerouting 2.5 0% (57% connected), 1.9 21%
M12 length tuning: nets with a custom length rule get meanders into range (test: KiCad DRC passes, untuned board fails)
M12: blind/buried vias (--blind-vias) and skew tuning; KiCad DRC clean on boards that allow blind vias

Placer: decoupling capacitors tied to the nearest IC supply pin (D25); full placement decaps 16-19 mm -> 1.8-3 mm from their IC, +1-9% HPWL. New bench/place_intent.py (decap/crystal distance, edge connectors, rotations).
placed2-tierA (place routable + route, 40 boards): 100% clean, 0 placement-added errors, 0 fallbacks; parts moved on 37/40; routed length 0.79x, vias 0.96x vs route-only; median placement 68 s.

placed2 (place routable + route, 132 boards): clean A 100/100, B 62.5/67.5, C 56.7/60, D 54.5/50 (place+route / route-only); 0 placement-added errors after excluding intra-footprint reclassification; 31 placement timeouts on C/D. Fixes: loop wall-time stop, final 4x verification route (B losses were 3M-check misjudgements).
placed3 tiers B-D launched with decap affinity + loop time limit + final verification
Planned feature documented: component-aware layout rules (docs/15-component-rules.md, docs/component_rules.yaml: 42 categories, 193 cited rules); docs only, not built

Placement comparison video report/compare_placement_SALSAFLOCK.mp4: FR 2.5.0-RC12 35/40 + 56 DRC errors on the designer's placement vs TraceMaker place+route 40/40 clean; CPU-thread strips from /proc sampling.
Placement video v2: 3D spin intro, shared clock (TraceMaker 142 s placing + 24 s routing vs Freerouting 22 s), vertical CPU thread and GPU (P100/V100) meters; CUDA confirmed in router cost fields.
Placement video v3: separate placement act (designer by hand vs TraceMaker 142 s), routing clock from routing start (Freerouting 14.5 s from its log, TraceMaker 12 s / job 24 s).

Progress dashboard corrected: D25 decap affinity, rotations, length/skew tuning, DAC2020 held-out marked done; experimental diff pairs/blind vias split from open work; M13 component-aware rules added.
Placement video for kitspace_aquarius (171 connections): TraceMaker 1,017 mm / 62 vias / 0 errors vs Freerouting 2,472 mm / 75 vias / 9 errors; caveat: placer moved indicator LEDs off their labels.
M13 component rules P0: catalogue JSON + detection + roles + tracemaker rules; labelled 41+12 PCBench boards, held-out precision 1.00 in every category except CAN (fixed)
M13 P1: tracemaker-place --component-rules soft: crystals 6.4->5.1 mm, ESD to connector 7.1->3.2 mm, HPWL equal, but decaps/regulator caps worse on some boards; default stays off (D31)
M13 P2/P3: generated crystal/inductor keep-outs (route --component-rules on, in memory only) + sidecar .kicad_dru checked by KiCad DRC; USB D+/D- pairs routed coupled via RouterOptions::pair_nets

M9 v1: escape corridors (opt-in), tracemaker escape feasibility analysis (42/1157 PCBench boards have pins that cannot escape under fixture rules), via neck-down (+24 d20_tri, +17 OtterCast), dead pins. Tiers A/B: no regressions.
M13 P0-P3 merged: src/crules (detection, roles, report, keep-outs, sidecar .kicad_dru), tracemaker rules, placer/router --component-rules (off by default after measured regressions); 75 tests pass.
Escape planning as a portfolio arm (2 of 8 variants): tier B 5,166 vs 5,163, tier C 9,526 vs 9,521 routed, clean pass unchanged (D33).

M13 P4: stackup read into the model; impedance solver (H&J, Cohn/Wheeler, K&J, Cohn coupled, GCPW) and IPC-2221 width; tracemaker rules reports widths/gaps per layer (report only). PCBench: 0 of 1157 unrouted boards have a stackup
D36-D39: impedance rules report-only; closed-form models; adjacent copper layer = reference plane; pairs solved at the Default class gap

M13: user override file (--rules-override: disable/assert/deny/set), Ethernet magnetics void ETH-05, opt-in connector edge attraction (--edge-attraction: mean connector edge distance 2.36 -> 1.81 mm over 23 boards, HPWL geo-mean +0.8% vs soft); ctest 102/102
Two-stage soft component-rule placement (D43): decaps unchanged, crystals 5.1->4.7 mm, load caps 2.4->2.0 mm, HPWL -1% over 23 boards x 3 seeds; component rules still off by default.
Held-out heldC (30 boards): clean 43.3% -> 50.0%, completion 96.5% -> 97.1%, 0 added errors (tonight's binary vs 2026-10-03).
Global router v2 start: corridor confinement worse on 10 hard boards (8,285 -> 7,936); 1M search cap +96 at fixed budget but not confirmed on tiers B/C; defaults unchanged, doc 05 §13.
Reachability pre-check (exact flood fill before likely-failing strict searches): 10 hard boards 8,285 -> 8,332 routed, no board worse; 0 mismatches vs full A*; tiers B/C running
D44: reachability pre-check on by default (--reach-check 1). Exact (0 mismatches vs full A*); 10 hard boards 8,285 -> 8,332; tiers A-D neutral (clean 100/67.5/63.3/50 %, unchanged)
Component rules placement gate: placed tiers B and C, --place routable, --component-rules off vs soft (same binary, run side by side)

M3: router heatmaps (expansions, history) live and in replay; zstd replay logs (--record FILE.zst, 12-13x smaller); viewer overlay (M). Boards identical with and without recording/viewing; D45 defers FlatBuffers
M13: verified the 41 R catalogue rules against sources: 9 confirmed, 9 corrected, 11 TraceMaker defaults (new evidence D, never hard; D45), 12 unverifiable stay R; doc 15 §8.10

M10: route --work output is bit-identical at any --threads (all 8 variants on a thread pool, total-order winner, D47); logicbone 3M: threads 1/3/8 identical to main's --threads 8; --variants 1/4 identical to main's --threads 1/4; new test thread_determinism; ctest 106/106
Side assignment: TraceMaker's footprint flip matches pcbnew FOOTPRINT::Flip on 2,529 footprints of 37 boards (0 differences; scripts/flip_check.py)
M7 side assignment (D48): opt-in --flip; 23 boards full/refine HPWL -7.9%/-7.6%, crossings -31%, 0 new KiCad DRC errors, via estimate 85 -> ~480; flip off byte-identical 23/23
M9: min-cost-flow channel + per-layer escape assignment for deep BGA arrays (--escape-flow, opt-in; tracemaker escape --flow, route --escape-report)

M9 escape flow, one variant fixed budgets on 7 deep-array BGA boards: off 2687, v1 corridors 2736, v2 flow 2703 routed; 0 added KiCad errors on 3 outputs; off/v1 byte-identical to main (6 boards); kept opt-in (D49)

M2 broken-board DRC parity: 264/264 injected-defect variants (11 demo boards x 12 defect kinds x 2 seeds) match kicad-cli violation by violation, was 41/264; KiCad 10 net propagation, any-net dangling, short/clearance split; demos 14/17 exact (was 12/17); PCBench routed sample 16/24 (was 1/24)

D52: tracemaker-place defaults to --component-rules soft. Placed tiers B+C off vs soft: clean 28->28, 18->18; XTAL-01 median 6.54->5.57 mm, load caps 3.11->2.81 mm, decaps unchanged. Routing default stays off

M12: differential pairs v2 (opt-in --diff-pairs, D50): coupled pair search with coupled vias, lazy breakout legs, re-coupling, enclosed-pin check, --pair-skew-mm, tracemaker pairs; 18 PCBench boards: 35/59 pairs >= 50 % coupled at the rule gap, completion 2,201 -> 2,210, no new KiCad error kinds
diff_pair ctest: USB hub 5 pairs 84-94 % coupled at 0.202 mm (rule 0.200), deterministic, KiCad DRC 0 errors; feature off byte-identical to main on 8 boards
Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later with a CUDA section 7 permission (LICENSE, NOTICE, SPDX headers). M12 merged; tier A 40/40 clean, 2,637 routed

M6 global congestion map (--global-congestion) with cut-based tile capacities: 18 hard boards, one variant, 100 M expansions: base 13,285, map 13,289-13,294 (noise), v1 corridors 12,933. Under 5 % of tiles reach 6/8 utilisation
D53: global congestion map stays off; rest of global router v2 deferred. Tier B-D failure breakdown: ~600 of ~960 unrouted are boxed-in pins, 137 no path in window, 171 never attempted

Router failure reasons now match the best state (they were overwritten by later restarts) and ripped victims say who ripped them. Nine nearly-clean boards: the last 1-5 unrouted connections are mostly rip-up oscillation between two or three nets at an IC, not sealed pins

Connection planning by pad copper-to-copper distance (--plan-gap): 24 boards, one variant, 60 M expansions: 11,905 -> 11,986 routed (15 boards better, 4 worse). Group re-route (R4 trial): no change on any board, removed. KiCad-judged tiers B/C/D running (plangap-*)

D54: connection planning by pad copper distance on by default. Tiers A-D neutral (A 2,637/100 %, B 5,166/67.5 %, C 9,522/63.3 %, D side by side 16,618 -> 16,622, 12/22 clean both), 0 added KiCad errors; fixed budget +81 on 24 boards. Group re-route removed (no change on any board)

DRC: zone fills tested through an edge index, area rules cached per fill: vme-wren 730 s -> 7 s, jetson 250 s -> 4 s, reports byte-identical to the linear reference (tests drc_zone_index, geom); test suite 694 s -> 334 s

Global router v2 (net-shared edges, via capacity, layer-true corridors, integer costs): 18 hard boards, 100 M expansions: base 13,305, corridors 12,967, confined 12,735, congestion map 13,324. Tile-graph routing 0.02-0.5 s per board
Designers' layouts under the benchmark judge: 6 of 92 tier B-D boards clean; pours stripped on 82 of 92. Skipping poured nets completes 4 of 34 non-clean boards (open 938 -> 723)
M6 closed (D55, D56): GPU cost-to-go fields in use; global router built and measured, off; GPU global routing and GPU DRC broad-phase not built, with the measurements that say why (doc 05 section 19)
Overnight run started: finish M8 (set S gate), then every open roadmap item; assumptions A35+ in dev/assumptions.md; report dev/morning-report-2026-10-07.md
M13: net classes from component rules (impedance width/gap, width for current) reach the router with --component-rules on (D58); StickHub USB pair 0.760/0.150 mm for 90 ohm, CM5 VBUS 1.367 mm for 3 A

M11: plugin round trip in a running KiCad 10.0.6 GUI (headless, Docker + Xvfb): copper added to the open board, one undo removes it, DRC of the saved board without new errors; PCM archive installed through the manager; plugin gains reroute, footprint moves and zone refill

M8 closed, gate not met: from-scratch placement on the held-out set S gives 85 % clean (34/40; human placement 95 %); gate is 90 %. Four of the six failing boards cannot be clean in any placement (D57)
Roadmap: every task in dev/progress.json is now built and measured or closed with its measurement (M2-M13). Gates not met: M8 (85 % vs 90 % from scratch) and M9 (BGA set 41 % clean)
M12: pair twists (59 pairs: >= 50 % coupled 35 -> 36, median 57 -> 63 %); half-pitch portfolio variant on small boards (tier B 27 -> 28 clean, tier C equal, +15 routed, 0 added errors)

Final checks: release 132/132, cpu-only 132/132; asan no sanitizer report, slow integration tests pass one by one after test-side fixes (work-budget tests no longer depend on wall time). Final tiers A/B/C/D clean 100 / 70 / 63.3 / 54.5 %, no added errors
Roadmap and test report: report/roadmap_testing.pdf (29 pages; tables generated by report/make_test_report.py from progress.json, the JUnit file and bench/results)
Fixtures pinned to the commits of the 0.8.0 results (TM_FIXTURES=latest overrides); fetch script builds the derived sets; compilers no longer fixed by the presets (CXX, TM_CUDA_HOST_CXX)

report/report.pdf brought up to release 0.8.0: final tier results and figures (final11; tier A times from final12-tierA run alone), testing section, new section on the work after 3 October, limitations

Issue #6: route options --no-tracks-on and --layer-cost (doc 05 §29, D76), through the per-net layer masks of §27. Six 4-layer PCBench boards, 60 s: inner-layer track 34 % -> 0 % (1,058 -> 1,038 of 1,078 routed) or 6 % at factor 4 (1,054 routed), no added DRC errors; defaults byte-identical on 10 boards; tier A 40/40 clean (layer-limits2-tierA); ctest release 165/165
D77: coupled-pair attempts charge every leg check as work and check the budget/time limit every 64 steps (CM5 fills kept: --work 20000 635 s -> 3.4 s; pairs off byte-identical)
D78: router obstacle tests use the zone-fill edge index (PolygonIndex); KiCad demos at 10M 515 -> 119 s, byte-identical

D81: bench sets (quick, mid, planes), run.py --work/--refill/--route-args/--set, compare_runs.py gates; plane fixtures via prepare_demos.py

D80: custom-rule conditions now follow KiCad 10.0.3 numeric, dropped-rule, typed ignore, item-layer, area/courtyard and via-span semantics. Positional predicates remain DRC-only; 29 rules tests and full non-parity ctest pass. Final corpus and quick routing comparison recorded in doc 05 section 33.

D80 follow-up: frozen KiCad 10.0.3 corpus 161/161 item-pair multisets, rejudge identical; rules 95985 assertions/32 cases; ctest 177 passed and 3 skipped; real demo parity 13/14 unchanged (existing tiny-tapeout annular mismatch), Jetson Via-Zone removals explained, vme-wren exact unchanged; final quick tier 30/30 clean/complete and byte-identical.
